mentions.name: Netflix Prize Challenge with LLM (netflix_challenge)
mentions.description: This project revisits the Netflix Prize challenge using LLMs, aiming to improve movie rating predictions. It has reached a 9% improvement mark so far and continues experimentation toward the 10% goal, with code hosted on GitHub.
mentions.problem: The Netflix Prize challenge targets a 10% improvement in predicting user movie ratings; the project is currently plateaued at 9% after initial progress.
mentions.source_excerpt:
https://github.com/mquan/netflix_challenge

I'm revisiting the Netflix Prize challenge with LLM. So far I've hit the 9% improvement mark within a couple weeks. I seem to have hit a wall in the last week or so with no further progress. I'm hopeful to hit the 10% goal with one of the many experimentations though.
mentions.author: quan
